title: Project wiki
summary: The project now has a wiki with developer guides, kept in the repository and published automatically.
changes: Add wiki pages under docs/wiki: home, sidebar, footer, a skeleton page for each guide, and full developer guides.
Add a workflow that publishes docs/wiki to the GitHub wiki when it changes on main.
Link the wiki from the README.
version_rationale: Patch: documentation and a publishing workflow only. Application code, routes, permissions and stored data are unchanged.
validation: Release history validation and the full PHPUnit suite in CI.
Manual review of the wiki pages and workflow.
known_limitations: Most user guide pages are skeletons and will be filled in milestone by milestone.
Edits made directly in the wiki are overwritten on the next sync.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No database change is involved.
